points.title: Completed action with 了
points.detail: 了 (le) after a verb marks a completed action: 我去了中国 (wǒ qù le Zhōngguó) "I went to China"; the negative is 没(有) and drops 了: 我没去 (wǒ méi qù).

points.title: Experience with 过
points.detail: 过 (guo) after a verb says the action has been experienced at least once: 我吃过北京烤鸭 (wǒ chī guo Běijīng kǎoyā) "I have eaten Peking duck"; 我没去过中国 (wǒ méi qù guo Zhōngguó).

points.title: Two actions at once with 一边……一边……
points.detail: 一边 (yìbiān) … 一边 … links two actions happening at the same time: 他一边走一边打电话 (tā yìbiān zǒu yìbiān dǎ diànhuà) "he talks on the phone while walking".

points.title: 旅行, 度假, 护照, 行李
points.detail: 旅行 (lǚxíng) is to travel and 度假 (dùjià) to go on holiday; 护照 (hùzhào) is a passport and 行李 (xíngli) luggage.

points.title: 预订, 机票, 酒店, 退房
points.detail: 预订 (yùdìng) means to book, 机票 (jīpiào) is a plane ticket and 酒店 (jiǔdiàn) a hotel; 入住 (rùzhù) is check-in and 退房 (tuìfáng) check-out.

points.title: The complement of manner with 得
points.detail: 得 (de) after a verb introduces a complement describing how the action is done: 他跑得很快 (tā pǎo de hěn kuài) "he runs very fast"; the negative is 跑得不快.

points.title: Result complements: 到, 住, 走, 上
points.detail: A result complement is a verb placed after another verb to show the result: 看见 (kànjiàn) "see", 找到 (zhǎodào) "find", 记住 (jìzhù) "remember", 关上 (guānshàng) "close".

points.title: More and more with 越来越……
points.detail: 越来越 (yuè lái yuè) "more and more" stands before an adjective or a mental verb: 天气越来越热了 (tiānqì yuè lái yuè rè le) "the weather is getting hotter and hotter".

points.title: 感冒, 发烧, 咳嗽, 药
points.detail: 感冒 (gǎnmào) is a cold, 发烧 (fāshāo) a fever, 咳嗽 (késou) a cough and 药 (yào) medicine: 我感冒了，要吃点儿药 (wǒ gǎnmào le, yào chī diǎnr yào).

points.title: 医院, 挂号, 大夫, 检查
points.detail: 医院 (yīyuàn) is a hospital, 挂号 (guàhào) to register, 大夫 (dàifu) a doctor and 检查 (jiǎnchá) to examine: 我去医院检查身体 (wǒ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá shēntǐ).

points.title: The 把 construction
points.detail: 把 (bǎ) moves the object in front of the verb to focus on what happens to it, and the verb must carry another element: 我把作业做完了 (wǒ bǎ zuòyè zuò wán le) "I finished the homework".

points.title: The passive with 被
points.detail: 被 (bèi) marks the passive, and the agent after it may be left out: 我的手机被弟弟拿走了 (wǒ de shǒujī bèi dìdi ná zǒu le) "my phone was taken by my little brother".

points.title: If … then … with 如果……就……
points.detail: 如果 (rúguǒ) … 就 (jiù) … is "if … then …": 如果明天有时间，我就去 (rúguǒ míngtiān yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù) "if I have time tomorrow, I will go".

points.title: 面试, 简历, 经验, 工资
points.detail: 面试 (miànshì) is an interview, 简历 (jiǎnlì) a résumé, 经验 (jīngyàn) experience and 工资 (gōngzī) a salary: 他有三年工作经验 (tā yǒu sān nián gōngzuò jīngyàn).

points.title: 同事, 经理, 加班, 请假
points.detail: 同事 (tóngshì) is a colleague and 经理 (jīnglǐ) a manager; 加班 (jiābān) is to work overtime and 请假 (qǐngjià) to ask for leave.

points.title: An action in progress with 正在……呢
points.detail: 正在 (zhèngzài) before a verb, often with 呢 (ne) at the end, marks an action in progress: 他正在打电话呢 (tā zhèngzài dǎ diànhuà ne) "he is on the phone right now".

points.title: Besides and except with 除了……以外
points.detail: 除了 (chúle) … 以外 (yǐwài) with 还 or 也 means "besides", and with 都 means "except": 除了汉语以外，我还学英语 (chúle Hànyǔ yǐwài, wǒ hái xué Yīngyǔ).

points.title: As soon as … with 一……就……
points.detail: 一 (yī) … 就 (jiù) … says one thing happens as soon as another does: 我一回家就睡觉 (wǒ yì huí jiā jiù shuìjiào) "I go to sleep as soon as I get home".

points.title: 手机, 短信, 微信, 邮件
points.detail: 手机 (shǒujī) is a mobile phone, 短信 (duǎnxìn) a text message, 微信 (Wēixìn) WeChat and 邮件 (yóujiàn) email: 我给你发微信 (wǒ gěi nǐ fā Wēixìn).

points.title: 新闻, 节目, 广告, 网络
points.detail: 新闻 (xīnwén) is the news, 节目 (jiémù) a programme, 广告 (guǎnggào) an advertisement and 网络 (wǎngluò) the internet.

points.title: Comparing with 比
points.detail: 比 (bǐ) compares two things as A比B+adjective, with 更 or 还 to intensify and 得多 after the adjective for a big difference: 今天比昨天热得多 (jīntiān bǐ zuótiān rè de duō).

points.title: The same as with 跟……一样
points.detail: 跟 (gēn) … 一样 (yíyàng) says two things are the same, and 不一样 that they differ: 我的意见跟你的一样 (wǒ de yìjiàn gēn nǐ de yíyàng).

points.title: Although … but … with 虽然……但是……
points.detail: 虽然 (suīrán) … 但是 (dànshì) … is "although … but …", and the two halves stay in that order: 虽然下雨了，但是我们还是去了 (suīrán xià yǔ le, dànshì wǒmen háishì qù le).

points.title: 春节, 中秋节, 礼物, 红包
points.detail: 春节 (Chūnjié) is the Spring Festival and 中秋节 (Zhōngqiūjié) the Mid-Autumn Festival; 礼物 (lǐwù) is a gift and 红包 (hóngbāo) a red envelope.

points.title: 高兴, 担心, 生气, 满意
points.detail: 高兴 (gāoxìng) is glad, 担心 (dānxīn) worried, 生气 (shēngqì) angry and 满意 (mǎnyì) satisfied: 我对他很满意 (wǒ duì tā hěn mǎnyì).

points.title: Ability and permission with 会, 能, 可以
points.detail: 会 (huì) is a learned skill, 能 (néng) an ability or circumstance and 可以 (kěyǐ) permission: 我会说汉语 (wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ); 这里可以停车吗？(zhèlǐ kěyǐ tíng chē ma?)

points.title: Because … so … with 因为……所以……
points.detail: 因为 (yīnwèi) … 所以 (suǒyǐ) … is "because … so …": 因为天气不好，所以我们在家 (yīnwèi tiānqì bù hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen zài jiā).

points.title: Softening a suggestion with 吧
points.detail: The particle 吧 (ba) softens a suggestion or a command: 我们走吧 (wǒmen zǒu ba) "let's go"; 你休息一下吧 (nǐ xiūxi yíxià ba) "why don't you take a rest".

points.title: 环境, 污染, 垃圾, 环保
points.detail: 环境 (huánjìng) is the environment, 污染 (wūrǎn) pollution, 垃圾 (lājī) rubbish and 环保 (huánbǎo) environmental protection: 我们应该保护环境 (wǒmen yīnggāi bǎohù huánjìng).

points.title: 将来, 计划, 希望, 努力
points.detail: 将来 (jiānglái) is the future, 计划 (jìhuà) a plan, 希望 (xīwàng) to hope and 努力 (nǔlì) to work hard: 我希望将来去中国工作 (wǒ xīwàng jiānglái qù Zhōngguó gōngzuò).
